blocks.text: The box is empty and Stone rest is outside the amount due.
Leave the offer alone if you only want Stoneground rye flour, 2 lb.
Last week's tag was $16.15. Today's tag eleven dollars and ninety one cents is the figure that will be billed.
Returns are accepted within 30 days when the seal is still intact.
Stone rest can be included for four dollars and two cents.

product.description: The flour is milled from whole rye berries and packed in a paper sack.
